رَدِيغٌ Thrown down, or prostrated; (IAar, K;) as also رَدِيعٌ. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And Foolish, or stupid, (JK, S, K,) and weak: (JK, TA:) this, and رَدِيعٌ, the former mentioned on the authority of Sh, and the latter on the authority of AHeyth, are thought by Az to mean foolish, or stupid. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
